study_identification_part.si4_title: Extreme deviations from the normative model reveal cortical heterogeneity and associations with negative symptom severity in first-episode psychosis from the OPTiMiSE and GAP studies

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Apply normative modeling of cortical thickness to first-episode psychosis (FEP) to quantify individual-level heterogeneity and test whether baseline deviations predict symptoms and remission over medium-term follow-up.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Group comparisons via Mann–Whitney U with Benjamini–Hochberg FDR; linear mixed-effects models relating baseline z-scores to longitudinal PANSS domains (negative/general/positive) and remission status; effects reported with coefficients, p-values, and odds ratios where applicable.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: FEP shows highly heterogeneous cortical thinning deviations; baseline negative CT deviations predict more severe negative symptoms over medium term and lower remission likelihood.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Regional overlap of extreme negative deviations was higher in FEP (2.29%) vs controls (0.87%, p < 0.0001, X^2 = 129.17); extreme positive deviations were lower in patients (0.71%) vs controls (0.92%, p = 0.014, X^2 = 6.05); median z-scores were significantly lower in FEP across 62 regions post FDR. LME: time effect p = 4×10^-6 (coef = -0.116); mean CT z-score effect on negative PANSS p = 0.001 (coef = -0.154); several regions remain significant after correction (e.g., left postcentral gyrus coef = -0.198, p < 0.001). Remission: time p = 0.0082 (coef = 0.433); thinner left central gyrus relates to lower remission (p = 0.0004, coef = 0.415, OR = 1.423).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Federated HBR adaptation enables multi-site integration without sharing patient data and avoids over-correction pitfalls when 'controlling' for site.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Potential confounding by antipsychotic exposure at scan; inability to assess ethnicity effects due to limited data in reference cohorts; challenges in measuring negative symptoms ideally requiring specific scales.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: Reference normative model built across multi-site European datasets via federated HBR; specific dataset names not provided. Imaging processed with FreeSurfer v6.0; Destrieux atlas (148 ROIs). QC used visual inspection. Adaptation used ~50% of available controls (ATLAS) with remaining controls+patients as test.
